mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at clear skies and 58 degrees near Reddan Soccer Park with a Waning Gibbous moon visible.

The Verona Police Department Records Section has updated its process for handling documents. You can now request motor vehicle crash reports online through crashdocs.org, which usually makes them available ten days after an incident. For other police records, remember that redactions may be required under state law, and the department works to process these requests within ten business days.
Today, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there are plenty of trivia options including events at Hop Haus Brewing, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's.
In a noteworthy call from the past week, on July 26, a 55-year-old woman was stopped for traveling 97 miles per hour and was subsequently arrested for an O W I.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. Since the store is currently closed, please note they open at 10:00 AM today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to Butter Pecan.
